slides.headline:
YOU DON'T
HAVE A
*CLOSER*
PROBLEM.
slides.sub: You have a volume problem wearing a closer costume.

slides.headline:
SIX CALLS
A *WEEK.*
slides.sub: Picture a commission-only closer with six calls on his calendar. He can't feed his family on that.

slides.headline:
THE GOOD ONES
*SAY NO.*
slides.sub: A closer who can sell does the math before he takes the seat. Six calls a week doesn't pay his mortgage, so he walks.

slides.headline:
SO WHO
*SAYS YES?*
slides.sub: The ones nobody else would hire. You didn't hire wrong. Your volume picked him.

slides.headline:
DO THE
*MATH* FIRST.
slides.sub: About 15 qualified calls a week. A 20% close rate. A $3,000 ticket. Below that, a closer makes the business worse.

slides.headline:
BELOW IT?
*YOU* CLOSE.
slides.sub: Keep taking the calls yourself. Put the money into getting to fifteen a week. Hire when the math can feed a closer.

slides.headline:
VOLUME FIRST.
*THEN* THE
CLOSER.
slides.sub: Count last week's qualified calls. One word: ABOVE or BELOW?
